Frequently Asked Questions: Glendale

Where is your Glendale office?

Our office is at 600 W. Broadway, STE 320, Glendale, CA 91204, in the heart of Glendale. We offer free parking nearby and can schedule in-person, phone, or video consultations.

Do you only handle Glendale car accident cases?

Car accidents are a core focus, but we handle all personal injury matters in Glendale, motorcycle crashes, pedestrian injuries, slip and falls, dog bites, premises liability, and wrongful death. If negligence caused your injury, we can evaluate your case.

How long do I have to file a lawsuit after an accident in Glendale?

California generally gives you two years from the date of injury to file a personal injury lawsuit. Claims against government entities may require a notice within six months. Contact us promptly so we can preserve evidence and protect your deadlines.

Will my case go to Glendale court?

Many Glendale injury cases settle without trial. If litigation is necessary, your case may be filed in Los Angeles County Superior Court, often at the Glendale courthouse or nearby LA County locations depending on where the accident occurred and where defendants reside.

What should I bring to my free Glendale consultation?

Bring any police reports, photos of the accident or injuries, insurance letters, medical records, and witness information if available. If you do not have documents yet, we can still advise you on next steps during a free consultation.
